Overview

Zug is a city in Zug with a population of 31,000. A wealthy city on Lake Zug with Switzerland’s lowest corporate tax rates, attracting global commodity traders and offering a high quality of life with Alpine views. Housing is notably more expensive than the national average. The overall cost of living is above the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5b growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. A large share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree or higher. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
